text: Binary per-row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment explicitly cites a specific real-world example offered to support or illustrate its argument, such as a concrete actual case, event, person, organization, place, study instance, or specific personal experience, in any domain; it need not be externally verified. Invented, hypothetical, purely generic scenarios and abstract generalizations do not count. Ignore text reporting OP view change, delta awards, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates or whether the outcome occurred (not evidence); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed but is not an example by itself. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies, including an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.
